text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1945234567 - High generation latency detected on hosted inference API (severity: P1). Alerts triggered for on-call. Pager: @Eric (oncall). Auto-escalation in 5m if not acknowledged.

Eric (oncall): taking pager, looking now. Any quick triage notes?

Jess (sre): seeing elevated 95th/99th gen latency on prod-us-west-1, affecting /v1/generate and streaming sessions. Error rates low, it's latency not 5xx. Starting trace sampling.

Eric (oncall): smart. pulling recent deploys and infra metrics. tagging this thread for comms: @Mike (commops) @Ana (product-ops).

Ana (product-ops): thanks. We need a short initial status page blurb we can publish within 10m. Keep it scoped and avoid speculation. Who's drafting?

Eric (oncall): I can draft initial. Suggest:

```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers may experience increased generation latency for the hosted inference API. Requests are not returning errors, but response times may be slower than normal.
Scope: Observed in region: us-west-1. We are actively investigating and will provide updates every 30 minutes or as we learn more.
ETA: No ETA yet.
```

Mike (commops): good start. Two edits: (1) change "Some customers" -> "A subset of customers" and (2) add a short note about workarounds if applicable. Also include link to status page once published.

Kiana (support): getting support queue hits about timeouts in streaming SDKs. Triage note for docs: advise customers to retry with small backoff if they see delays.

Eric (oncall): updated draft pasted:

```
Status: Investigating
Impact: A subset of customers may experience increased generation latency for the hosted inference API (particularly in the us-west-1 region). Requests should not fail but may return slower.
Scope: Affected endpoints include /v1/generate and streaming APIs for longer-context workloads.
Mitigation: We are investigating root cause and applying mitigations. If you see severe delays, try a short client-side retry/backoff.
Update cadence: 30m until resolved.
```

Mike (commops): LGTM. I'll prep the statuspage entry and customer notification template. Posting publish checklist: 1) Confirm scope wording with SRE, 2) Confirm no PII exposure, 3) Add link to incident updates (this thread), 4) Publish initial statuspage entry, 5) Notify top affected customers via account owners.

Jess (sre): quick update: traces point to a regression in KV cache hit rate after a recent kernel change on the gradient-quantization path. We're reverting the kernel selection on a test shard now. If revert looks good, we'll roll to a small fraction of capacity.

Eric (oncall): rolling revert to 10% of us-west capacity now. Watch for latency delta.

incident-bot: Deploy action started by Eric (oncall): revert-kernel-selection -> rollout: 10% (id: deploy-1945234590).

Jess (sre): after the revert on test shard, p50 improved, p95 dropped ~40%. Monitoring the 10% rollout.

(30m later)

Eric (oncall): status update for statuspage: we've deployed a partial rollback to kernel selection which has reduced latency for the affected shard. We are ramping the rollback across us-west; customers should see gradual improvement over the next 30-45 minutes. No customer data loss or errors observed.

Mike (commops): publishing update to status page now. DRAFT for publish: 

```
Update (30m): We have identified a regression affecting cache efficiency in a kernel selection path used by the inference runtime. A partial rollback has been deployed and is showing reduced latencies. We are ramping the rollback and monitoring. Customers may notice intermittent improvement as traffic shifts.
```

Ana (product-ops): add a short line about affected features: "primarily impacts long-context generation and streaming sessions" and include regions if we can.

Mike (commops): added. Preparing to push to public status page. Link (internal): https://status.internal.redwood.example/incidents/1945234567 (will replace with public URL once published).

Kiana (support): support template for customers experiencing delays: 

"We're investigating increased generation latency for hosted inference in us-west-1. Our engineers have deployed a rollback that is reducing latency; please retry after 30s. If you continue to see issues, reply with request id and timestamps and we'll prioritize your ticket."

Mike (commops): published initial and 30m update to public status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1945234567. Sent internal announce to #customers-ops.

(45m later)

Jess (sre): ramp complete across us-west. p95 back to baseline within noise. No further regressions observed in the last 10m. Leaving traces to validate for next 1h.

Eric (oncall): marking for resolution check: run synthetic workloads and confirm stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Reminder: please run post-incident checklist and file postmortem doc if incident severity >= P1.

Mike (commops): prepping resolved copy. Proposed resolved notice: 

```
Resolved: The issue causing increased generation latency in us-west-1 has been resolved. We identified a regression in kernel selection impacting cache efficiency and deployed a rollback; latency has returned to expected levels. No customer data was lost. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support with request ids.
```

Ana (product-ops): Looks good. Add "root cause analysis forthcoming" so customers know we'll follow up.

Mike (commops): done. Publishing resolved notice to status page now and sending follow-up email to 12 impacted accounts via account owners.

Kiana (support): support queue note: closing related tickets and adding follow-up tags.

Eric (oncall): marking this thread as resolved from on-call side. Will attach timeline and metrics to the postmortem doc.

Jess (sre): adding debugging notes and kernel change diff link to the postmortem draft.

Mike (commops): resolved notice published (public): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1945234567/resolved. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.

Eric (oncall): good job team.

incident-bot: Incident 1945234567 -> RESOLVED. Duration: ~58m. Postmortem required: yes.

(End of thread)
